title: Sharing Platform — implementation
summary: Allow users to share models with controlled visibility (public, private, unlisted), shareable URLs and clean read-only public views. Tracks all implementation stories for this epic.
acceptance_criteria: An owner can set a model to public, private or unlisted
Public and unlisted models render read-only to non-owners
Private models are inaccessible to anyone but the owner
Share URLs resolve correctly per visibility rules
notes:
Scope (in): Visibility states: public, private, unlisted; Shareable URLs; Read-only public views
Out of scope: Ranking/comparison (EPIC-007); Comments/social interaction (future); Collaborative editing (future)
